title: Gap analysis interviews
source_system: Interviews (IT Manager and Systems Administrators 2026-07-15; Director of Engineering and Contracts Manager 2026-07-16; HR Manager and Plant Manager 2026-07-17; Manufacturing Systems Engineer)
what_it_shows: Owners' descriptions of how each SP 800-171 requirement and clause duty is carried out today. The IT Manager states that logs are collected and not reviewed, that changes are made without a security impact review, that incident response has never been tested and that no procedure exists for compromise review or malware submission. The Systems Administrators state that logged event types have never been reviewed, that changes are made without a request or log, and that no vulnerability scans are run. The Director of Engineering states that 3 engineers pasted CUI specification text into public chatbots (2026-07-16). The Contracts Manager states that the company has never practiced a DIBNet report, has no named reporters, tracks incidents in email and has no step to pass DoD incident numbers to the primes. The HR Manager states that there is no role-based training. The Plant Manager states that about 40 operators know the shared MES passwords, that escort on the shop floor varies, including for foreign-national employees of commercial customers, and that paper copies go to outside processors in unsealed envelopes. The Manufacturing Systems Engineer states that CNC controller storage and MES drives go out for repair without sanitization. The MSP holds no enclave accounts (confirmed 2026-07-16)
